name: Timbuktu 52 Days Sign
hero_subtitle: The most photographed sign in the south — a reminder of the old camel caravan route to Timbuktu.

overview.title: Fifty-two days by camel
overview.p1: The weathered sign reading “Timbuktu — 52 days” (Tomboctou 52 jours) is Zagora’s postcard image. It marks the memory of caravan routes that once linked this oasis corridor to the Sahel.
overview.p2: It is a short stop, not a full site: come for the photo, the context, and the reminder that Zagora was a gateway long before modern tourism.
overview.p3: Pair it with a palm-grove walk the same morning so the day feels fuller than a single roadside pause.

q1.question: Is it free?

q2.question: Best light?
q2.answer: Morning is often kinder for photos than harsh midday.

q3.question: How long to spend?

q4.question: Is the distance accurate?
